title: Shop Supplies Fee on Brake Repair Orders
content:
**Shop supplies fee — Brake Service Warranties.** On a paid brake visit the shop supplies fee is the line's percentage of the labor on the repair order, and it never exceeds the line's highest fee per repair order. It is not charged on a visit where all labor is covered.

| Brake service line | Fee, percent of labor | Highest fee per repair order | Charged on a visit where all labor is covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 5 | 35.00 | No |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 5 | 35.00 | No |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 5 | 35.00 | No |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 5 | 35.00 | No |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 5 | 35.00 | No |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 5 | 35.00 | No |

**Illustrations on hypothetical labor amounts** (the labor figures are illustrative, not any line's price):

| Hypothetical labor on the repair order | 5 percent of that labor | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 — below the highest fee |
| 700.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 — equal to the highest fee |
| 900.00 | 45.00 | 35.00 — held at the highest fee |
| all labor covered | — | none |
